name: Priya
text:
Order LK-68251

Hello,

The kettle from my order turned up with a cracked lid and a dent in the side. The bookcase on the same order was promised for last Tuesday and still hasn't come. And I've gone off the toaster, which is still sealed in its box, so I'd like my money back for that one.

Thanks,
Priya

name: Tom
text:
Order LK-45110

Hello,

The desk chair came with only three of its five castors. Your driver left the rug behind the bins at number 14, which isn't my house (I'm at 41), and it's soaked through. Separately, my son put a football through the mirror I bought from you, which is entirely on us. Could you send me another?

Thanks,
Tom

name: Aisha
text:
Order LK-55272

Hello,

I've been staring at the instructions for the wardrobe for two hours and can't work out how the doors go on. Please also cancel the parasol, it hasn't left you yet and I've found one locally. And why did I pay £35 to have the sofa bed brought round when the website said free?

Thanks,
Aisha

name: Callum
text:
Order LK-30519

Hello,

My slow cooker stopped heating after eight months and I'd like to claim on the guarantee. The gas hose on the patio heater feels loose and I honestly don't feel safe lighting it. And the 20% off code from your newsletter wouldn't go through on the bath mat.

Thanks,
Callum

name: Beth
text:
Order LK-70066

Hello,

I ordered a king size duvet and you've sent a single. Could the ironing board go to my office at 7 Mill Lane rather than home? And when the new bed comes on Friday, can your men take away the old mattress?

Thanks,
Beth

name: Marek
text:
Order LK-51146

Hello,

I need a VAT invoice for the tool chest for my business accounts. My card statement shows the step ladder twice, same amount, same day. Can I pay for the hammock over three months rather than in one go?

Thanks,
Marek

name: Sofia
text:
Order LK-95333

Hello,

Do you know when the dog bed will be back on the shelves? It's been out for weeks. We run a small chain of cafes and want fourteen of the wall clock, is there a bulk price for businesses? Also the plant pot turned out too big for the windowsill and I'd like my money back.

Thanks,
Sofia

name: Hassan
text:
Order LK-86381

Hello,

The picture frame arrived with the glass in pieces. The coffee table was due on Monday and nobody has been. And I left your watering can out in the frost and it split, my own fault, but could I have another one?

Thanks,
Hassan

name: Olivia
text:
Order LK-24488

Hello,

The bike rack box had none of the wall bolts in it. The courier left my storage basket in the car park of the flats next door. And I was charged £12 to get a curtain pole delivered, which seems a lot for a stick.

Thanks,
Olivia

name: Dan
text:
Order LK-33794

Hello,

I can't for the life of me work out how to assemble the high chair, the tray won't clip on. Could you cancel the doormat please, it's not been dispatched yet. Your welcome code keeps being rejected on the laundry hamper too.

Thanks,
Dan

name: Nadia
text:
Order LK-19676

Hello,

The stand mixer stopped turning last week, only ten months old, and I want to use the guarantee. The floor lamp gave me a small shock when I touched the switch, which has me worried. And when you bring the new settee could you take away my old sofa bed?

Thanks,
Nadia

name: Rui
text:
Order LK-15617

Hello,

The shower curtain I got is grey and I ordered blue. Can the cat tree be sent to my mother's address in Leeds instead of mine? And is there a way of spreading the cost of the wardrobe across six months?

Thanks,
Rui

name: Greta
text:
Order LK-72170

Hello,

Please could I have a VAT invoice for the mattress. My bank has taken the money for the towel rail twice. And the dish rack doesn't fit my sink, so I'd like my money back on that.

Thanks,
Greta

name: Ife
text:
Order LK-72606

Hello,

When will you have the bedside table in stock again? I run a nursery and we'd like twenty of the play tent, so is there a bulk price for that? And our cat knocked my kettle off the counter and smashed it, all her doing, so can I get another?

Thanks,
Ife

name: Liam
text:
Order LK-42847

Hello,

The hammock arrived with a big tear along one edge. The ironing board should have been here on Saturday. And I paid £9 to get the bookcase delivered even though I spent over the limit where you said delivery was free.

Thanks,
Liam

name: Yuki
text:
Order LK-28546

Hello,

My step ladder arrived without the rubber feet that are meant to be in the box. Your driver dumped my parasol at the neighbour's gate when I was home all day. And the code from the flyer says invalid when I try it on the mirror.

Thanks,
Yuki

name: Amara
text:
Order LK-47689

Hello,

The bike rack has defeated me, I can't see how the arms fit together at all. Please cancel the slow cooker while it's still in your warehouse. When the new rug arrives, can the driver please take the old rug away with him?

Thanks,
Amara

name: Jonas
text:
Order LK-57489

Hello,

The patio heater won't light any more, it's eleven months old, and I'd like to make a claim under the guarantee. My daughter's high chair wobbles when she leans over and one leg looks like it could give way, so I don't feel she's safe in it. Also I'd like to pay for the tool chest monthly over a few months if you offer that.

Thanks,
Jonas

name: Chloe
text:
Order LK-25337

Hello,

You've sent the small bath mat and I ordered the large. Could the dog bed go to my sister's at 22 Fern Road instead? The picture frame also isn't what I wanted after all, so I'd like my money back on it.

Thanks,
Chloe

name: Farid
text:
Order LK-99147

Hello,

My accountant wants a VAT invoice for the desk chair. I've looked at my statement and the coffee table has been charged twice. I tripped and fell into the floor lamp and bent it beyond repair, which is my fault, but can you send me another?

Thanks,
Farid

name: Mei
text:
Order LK-90289

Hello,

Any idea when the towel rail will be available again? We're fitting out a hotel and need sixty of the storage basket, what can you do on price for a company? And I paid £15 to have a dish rack delivered, which was more than the rack.

Thanks,
Mei

name: Owen
text:
Order LK-45675

Hello,

The stand mixer was dented when I opened the box and the bowl has a crack. The plant pot was meant to be here by Wednesday and still isn't. And the spring sale code didn't apply when I tried it on the bookcase.

Thanks,
Owen

name: Zara
text:
Order LK-82785

Hello,

The cat tree came without the post that holds up the top shelf. The courier put my kettle in the recycling bin outside, of all places. And could you take away the old wardrobe when you deliver the new one?

Thanks,
Zara

name: Ben
text:
Order LK-35638

Hello,

Could someone explain how to assemble the sofa bed, because the frame doesn't line up the way the leaflet shows. Please cancel the laundry hamper, I can see it hasn't been sent. And can I split the cost of the mattress over several months?

Thanks,
Ben

name: Dina
text:
Order LK-19910

Hello,

My wall clock has stopped working after a few months and I'd like to claim on the guarantee. The top step of the step ladder bends when I stand on it and I don't feel safe using it. I've also decided against the curtain pole, so I'd like my money back on that.

Thanks,
Dina

name: Kofi
text:
Order LK-93076

Hello,

The plant pot you delivered is terracotta and I ordered white. Could the rug go to our new flat, 3 Canal Street, rather than the old one? And our puppy chewed the dog bed to bits, our own fault, so can you send me another?

Thanks,
Kofi

name: Ines
text:
Order LK-36107

Hello,

Please send me a VAT invoice for the dish rack. I've been billed twice for the bedside table according to my banking app. And why does it cost £18 to deliver a high chair?

Thanks,
Ines

name: Harry
text:
Order LK-20606

Hello,

When is the shower curtain going to be back in stock? The toaster was promised for yesterday and hasn't turned up. And the friends and family code won't work on the duvet.

Thanks,
Harry

name: Leila
text:
Order LK-16786

Hello,

The doormat came with one corner ripped off. The courier left my laundry hamper at the post office without telling me. And when you drop off the new one, could you take away my old bike rack?

Thanks,
Leila

name: Sam
text:
Order LK-71696

Hello,

The bookcase is short of two shelf pins so I can't finish it. Please cancel the towel rail before it goes out. And is it possible to pay for the patio heater over several months?

Thanks,
Sam

name: Anya
text:
Order LK-99030

Hello,

I need someone to tell me how to assemble the cat tree, because the diagram makes no sense. The handle on the kettle gets so hot that it burned my hand, and I'm worried it isn't safe. I'd also like my money back on the slow cooker, which I've decided I don't need.

Thanks,
Anya

name: Reza
text:
Order LK-93308

Hello,

The floor lamp has stopped working and I'd like to make a claim under its guarantee. Could you send the picture frame to my work address, 40 Quay Road, instead? And I reversed over the tool chest in the drive, completely my doing, so could you send another?

Thanks,
Reza

name: Holly
text:
Order LK-51353

Hello,

The rug is green and I ordered the navy. My card has been charged twice for the parasol. And I'd like someone to explain the £22 I paid to have a hammock delivered, as it weighs almost nothing.

Thanks,
Holly

name: Dev
text:
Order LK-21410

Hello,

I need a VAT invoice for the play tent, please. The mirror is hanging from a fixing that pulled out of the wall, and I'm frightened it will fall on someone. And your code from the email wouldn't take on the stand mixer.

Thanks,
Dev

name: Noor
text:
Order LK-24428

Hello,

Will the watering can be back in stock this month? We're a landscaping firm and want thirty of the garden bench, do you offer a bulk price to businesses? And can you take away my old desk chair when the new one comes?

Thanks,
Noor

name: Erik
text:
Order LK-57541

Hello,

The wardrobe has a split right down one door and it came like that. The table lamp was due on Thursday and I've heard nothing. And could I pay off the sofa bed in monthly amounts rather than all at once?

Thanks,
Erik
